definition_en: the point where light or attention meets, or to direct attention or a lens there
core_image: 放大镜把阳光聚成一点，纸面冒起一缕烟
scene: 请把注意力集中在题目上。 Please focus on the question.
sceneCN: 这里 focus 是「集中」（第 2 个义项）；句意：请把注意力集中在题目上。

senses.title: Point of light
senses.definition: the point where rays of light meet
senses.definitionCN: 光线汇聚的那一点
senses.example: Adjust the lens until the image is in focus.
senses.exampleCN: 调节镜头直到图像清晰对焦。
senses.why: This is the original optical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最初的光学义项。

senses.title: To concentrate
senses.definition: to direct attention toward something
senses.definitionCN: 把注意力引向某事物
senses.example: Please focus on the question.
senses.exampleCN: 请把注意力集中在题目上。
senses.why: Attention is treated like a beam of light.
senses.whyCN: 注意力被当作一束光。

senses.title: To adjust a lens
senses.definition: to make an image clear by moving a lens
senses.definitionCN: 移动镜头使图像清晰
senses.example: She focused the camera on the bird.
senses.exampleCN: 她把相机对准鸟儿对焦。
senses.why: The verb keeps the optical action.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留了光学的动作。

senses.title: Main point
senses.definition: the central subject of attention
senses.definitionCN: 注意力的中心主题
senses.example: Cost is the main focus of the report.
senses.exampleCN: 成本是这份报告的重点。
senses.why: The meeting point of rays becomes a topic.
senses.whyCN: 光线的汇聚点引申为话题。

intro.en: Focus is Latin for hearth, the fireplace at the centre of a home.
intro.cn: focus 在拉丁语中意为壁炉，即家宅中央的火塘。

items.en: Focus meant a hearth or fireplace.
items.cn: focus 意为壁炉或火塘。

items.en: Opticians used focus for the point of rays.
items.cn: 光学家用 focus 表示光线的汇聚点。

items.en: Focus entered English as an optical term.
items.cn: focus 作为光学术语进入英语。

items.en: Focus extended to attention and importance.
items.cn: focus 扩展到注意力与重要性。

items.en: Focus became a common verb meaning concentrate.
items.cn: focus 成为表示集中的常用动词。

note.en: Focus is compared with similar-looking words and with words for attention and centres.
note.cn: 把 focus 与形近词以及表示注意力和中心的词作比较。

entries.definition: trickery, used in the phrase hocus-pocus
entries.definitionCN: 哄骗（见于 hocus-pocus）

entries.definition: giving clear attention
entries.definitionCN: 专注的

entries.definition: plural of focus
entries.definitionCN: focus 的复数

entries.definition: the middle point
entries.definitionCN: 中心

entries.definition: the act of watching or listening carefully
entries.definitionCN: 注意力

entries.definition: to give all your attention
entries.definitionCN: 集中注意力

normalIntro.en: Focus is a meeting point: light, attention, or the main topic all gather there.
normalIntro.cn: focus 是一个汇聚点：光、注意力或主要话题都在那里聚集。

normal.en: Focus on your homework.
normal.cn: 专心做作业。

normal.en: The camera is in focus.
normal.cn: 相机对焦清晰。

normal.en: The main focus is safety.
normal.cn: 重点是安全。

normal.en: He lost focus during the lecture.
normal.cn: 他听讲座时走神了。

normal.en: Focus the light on the paper.
normal.cn: 把光聚在纸上。

abstract.en: Attention is a beam you can point.
abstract.cn: 注意力是一束可以指向的光。

abstract.en: A clear focus leaves the rest blurred.
abstract.cn: 清晰的焦点让其余部分变模糊。

abstract.en: A hearth and a lens both gather people and light.
abstract.cn: 火塘聚人，镜头聚光。

examples.en: Please focus on the question.
examples.cn: 请把注意力集中在题目上。

examples.en: She focused the camera on the bird.
examples.cn: 她把相机对准鸟儿对焦。

examples.en: Cost is the main focus of the report.
examples.cn: 成本是这份报告的重点。

dict_mnemonic.text: focus 原指家中火塘，是一家人目光汇聚之处；后来指光线汇聚的焦点，再指注意力的集中点。

root: 源自拉丁语 focus（火塘、壁炉），核心义「汇聚的中心点」。

sensesIntro.en: Focus means an optical point, to concentrate, to adjust a lens, or the main point.
sensesIntro.cn: focus 意为焦点、集中、对焦或重点。

core.en: A point where rays or attention come together.
core.cn: 光线或注意力汇聚的一点。

branches.en: Light rays meet at one point.
branches.cn: 光线在一点相遇。

branches.en: The mind gathers on one task.
branches.cn: 心思聚集在一项任务上。

branches.en: The lens is moved until clear.
branches.cn: 移动镜头直到清晰。

branches.en: A report centres on one subject.
branches.cn: 报告围绕一个主题。

branches.en: Light and attention follow the same geometry.
branches.cn: 光与注意力遵循同样的几何。

intro.en: Focus forms a family of attention and lens words.
intro.cn: focus 形成一个表示注意力与镜头的词族。

latinIntro.en: Focus is a Latin word for hearth; it has no productive Latin affixes.
latinIntro.cn: focus 是拉丁语中表示火塘的词；它在拉丁语中没有能产后缀。

items.exampleCN: 她给出了重点明确的回答。

items.example: Let us refocus on the plan.

items.meaning: a camera system that focuses itself
items.exampleCN: 这部手机自动对焦很快。

definition_en: the reason or system on which something is built or done
core_image: 一本书最前面那页写着写作依据
scene: 会议上有人提出质疑。 The claim has no basis in fact.
sceneCN: 这里 basis 是「依据」（第 2 个义项：支持某种说法的理由）；句意是这一说法没有事实依据。

derivatives.zh: 同源基础词，义为「基础；底部」

senses.title: A system or footing
senses.definition: the system or regular way in which something is done
senses.definitionCN: 做某事所依据的制度或固定方式
senses.example: The staff meet on a weekly basis.
senses.exampleCN: 员工每周开一次会。
senses.why: Basis is Latin for a pedestal, so a regular footing for work is called a basis.
senses.whyCN: basis 在拉丁语中意为基座，所以工作的固定依托也叫 basis。

senses.title: A reason
senses.definition: the reason or evidence that supports a claim
senses.definitionCN: 支持某种说法的理由或证据
senses.example: The claim has no basis in fact.
senses.exampleCN: 这一说法没有事实依据。
senses.why: A claim rests on evidence the way a building rests on a base, which gives the sense of grounds.
senses.whyCN: 主张依靠证据，正如建筑依靠基座，于是产生「依据」义。

intro.en: Basis is a Latin word that English borrowed whole.
intro.cn: basis 是英语整体借入的拉丁词。

items.en: basis meant 'a step or pedestal'.
items.cn: basis 意为「台阶、基座」。

items.en: basis kept the same sense.
items.cn: basis 保留了同样的含义。

items.en: basis named a foundation for argument.
items.cn: basis 指论证的基础。

items.en: on a daily basis became common.
items.cn: on a daily basis 成为常见说法。

items.en: basis is common in law and science.
items.cn: 如今 basis 常见于法律与科学。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bas- opening; the near-meaning group gives foundation words.
note.cn: 形近组都以 bas- 开头；近义组是「基础、根据」的说法。

entries.definition: most necessary
entries.definitionCN: 基本的

entries.definition: a round open container
entries.definitionCN: 盆

entries.definition: more than one base
entries.definitionCN: 基础（复数）

entries.definition: the solid base of a building
entries.definitionCN: 地基

entries.definition: a reason for something
entries.definitionCN: 理由；根据

entries.definition: the bottom or starting point

normalIntro.en: A basis is the footing a claim or habit stands on.
normalIntro.cn: basis 是主张或习惯所立足的根基。

normal.en: The plural is bases.
normal.cn: 复数是 bases。

normal.en: On a daily basis means every day.
normal.cn: on a daily basis 意为每天。

normal.en: On the basis of means according to.
normal.cn: on the basis of 意为根据。

normal.en: No basis in fact means unsupported.
normal.cn: no basis in fact 意为没有事实依据。

normal.en: Do not confuse basis with basic.
normal.cn: 不要把 basis 与 basic 混淆。

abstract.en: See a footnote under a firm statement.
abstract.cn: 想象一句断言下面标着脚注。

abstract.en: See a calendar with every day crossed.
abstract.cn: 想象日历上每天都划了叉。

abstract.en: See a scale weighing evidence.
abstract.cn: 想象天平在称量证据。

examples.en: The staff meet on a weekly basis.
examples.cn: 员工每周开一次会。

examples.en: The claim has no basis in fact.
examples.cn: 这一说法没有事实依据。

examples.en: They judged the work on the basis of quality.
examples.cn: 他们根据质量来评判这项工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: basis 与 base 同根：脚下站稳的那块基座，就是基础与依据。

root: 直接借自拉丁语 basis，源于希腊语 basis「台阶、基座」；由实物基座引申为做事的「方式」与论证的「依据」。

sensesIntro.en: A regular footing and a supporting reason are both what something stands on.

senses.title: The act of opposing
senses.definition: the act of fighting against a person, plan, or system
senses.definitionCN: 对抗某人、计划或制度的行为
senses.example: The plan met with strong resistance from residents.
senses.exampleCN: 这项计划遭到居民的强烈抵抗。
senses.why: The noun names the standing-against itself.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指「站到对面」这一行为本身。

senses.title: A force that slows motion
senses.definition: a physical force that opposes movement, or the property that limits electric current
senses.definitionCN: 阻碍运动的物理力，或限制电流的性质
senses.example: The wire has low electrical resistance.
senses.exampleCN: 这根导线的电阻很低。
senses.why: Physical resistance is the same opposition seen in materials and circuits.
senses.whyCN: 物理阻力是同样的「对抗」在材料与电路中的体现。

senses.title: The ability to withstand disease or drugs
senses.definition: the ability of a body, plant, or germ to remain unharmed by a disease or drug
senses.definitionCN: 身体、植物或病菌不受疾病或药物伤害的能力
senses.example: The bacteria have developed resistance to common antibiotics.
senses.exampleCN: 这些细菌对常见抗生素产生了耐药性。
senses.why: A living thing standing against attack is resistance in the biological sense.
senses.whyCN: 生物顶住侵害，就是生物学意义上的抵抗。

intro.en: Resistance comes from Latin resistere, to stand against, through Old French, with the English noun ending -ance.

items.en: Resistance appears as the act of resisting.

abstract.en: Think of a wall absorbing the force of a wave.

senses.title: A machine between floors
senses.definition: a cage or platform in a building that carries people or goods up and down between floors
senses.definitionCN: 建筑中在楼层之间运送人或货的轿厢或平台
senses.example: The elevator stopped at the fourteenth floor.
senses.exampleCN: 电梯停在了十四层。
senses.why: The -or ending names the thing that does the verb, so elevator is literally the lifter, and the machine that lifts became the word.
senses.whyCN: -or 词尾命名做这个动作的东西，所以 elevator 字面就是「举升者」，负责举升的机器便得了这个名字。

senses.title: A flap on the tail
senses.definition: a hinged control surface on the tailplane of an aircraft that makes the nose go up or down
senses.definitionCN: 飞机水平尾翼上可转动的操纵面，使机头抬起或低下
senses.example: The pilot pushed the elevator down and the nose dropped.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员推下升降舵，机头随即下沉。
senses.why: The flap literally lifts or lowers the nose, so aviation reused the same agent noun for the part that does it.
senses.whyCN: 这块舵面确实在抬起或压低机头，于是航空业把同一个施动名词用在了做这件事的部件上。

senses.title: A grain lifter
senses.definition: a tall building or machine that lifts and stores grain in bulk
senses.definitionCN: 把谷物大批提升并储存的高塔或机械
senses.example: The grain was trucked to the elevator beside the railway.
senses.exampleCN: 谷物被卡车运到铁路旁的谷物提升机。
senses.why: Farm machinery needed a plain name for a machine that raises grain, and the oldest sense of lift fitted exactly.
senses.whyCN: 农业机械需要给「把谷物举高」的机器一个朴素名称，而 lift 最古老的含义正合适。

intro.en: Elevator is elevate plus the Latin agent ending -or, so it means the lifter; American English applied it to the machine, while British English kept lift.
intro.cn: elevator 是 elevate 加拉丁语施动词尾 -or，意为「举升者」；美式英语把它用在机器上，英式英语则保留 lift。

items.en: The agent ending -or made a noun meaning one that lifts.

items.en: American English fixed the word on the passenger machine in tall buildings.
items.cn: 美式英语把这个词固定给高层建筑里的载人机器。

items.en: British lift and American elevator now name the same box, and aviation took the word for a tail flap.

definition_zh: 提议；建议；打算；求婚；提名
definition_en: to put forward a plan or idea for others to consider; to ask someone to marry you; to intend to do something; to nominate someone formally
core_image: 一只手把写着想法的纸推到桌面中央，抬头看向众人
scene: 小组讨论卡住时，最年轻的成员把一张草稿推到桌子中间，请大家先看他的思路。 She proposed a shorter timetable so that the team could test the design earlier.
sceneCN: 这里 propose 是「提出、提议」（第 1 个义项：把计划或想法提出来供人考虑）；句意为她提出一个更短的时间表，好让团队更早测试设计。图中可辨识物件：草稿纸、圆桌、马克杯。

pos.zh: 提议；建议；打算；求婚；提名

derivatives.zh: propose 加名词后缀 -al（末尾 e 脱落），义为「提议；方案；求婚」
propose 加表示「做某事的人」的后缀 -r，义为「提议者；提出者」
与 propose 同出拉丁 proponere，义为「命题；主张」
propose 的过去分词作形容词，义为「拟议中的；提议的」

senses.title: To put forward a plan or idea
senses.definition: to suggest a plan, idea, or course of action for other people to consider
senses.definitionCN: 提出计划、想法或行动方案供他人考虑
senses.example: The engineer proposed a cheaper way to reinforce the roof.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师提出了一种更便宜的屋顶加固办法。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to place something in front of someone, so proposing is literally laying an idea on the table for others to look at.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词本义是「把东西摆到某人面前」，所以 propose 就是字面意义上的「把想法放到桌面上」让人看。

senses.title: To ask someone to marry you
senses.definition: to ask a person to marry you, usually in a formal or planned way
senses.definitionCN: 请求某人嫁给自己或娶自己，通常正式或经过安排
senses.example: He proposed to her beside the river where they first met.
senses.exampleCN: 他在两人初遇的河边向她求婚。
senses.why: An offer of marriage is placed before the other person like a plan, and the answer comes back as a decision in the same way.
senses.whyCN: 求婚也像一份方案那样摆到对方面前，对方的回答同样是一次决定。

senses.title: To intend or plan to do something (formal)
senses.definition: to intend to do something, especially as a stated plan
senses.definitionCN: 打算做某事，尤指作为已说明的计划
senses.example: The council proposes to close the lane to traffic on Sundays.
senses.exampleCN: 市政会打算在周日封闭这条小路，禁止车辆通行。
senses.why: What is set before people as a plan also states what the speaker means to do, so the verb comes to mark intention.
senses.whyCN: 摆在众人面前的计划同时也表明了说话人打算做什么，于是这个动词便能标示「意图」。

senses.title: To nominate someone or put a motion formally
senses.definition: to name a person for a position, or to present a motion for a formal vote
senses.definitionCN: 提名某人担任某职，或提出动议交付正式表决
senses.example: She was proposed as the next chair of the society.
senses.exampleCN: 有人提名她担任协会的下一任主席。
senses.why: A name can be placed before a group just as an idea can, so one verb covers nominating a person and moving a motion.
senses.whyCN: 名字和想法一样都能被摆到一群人面前，所以同一个动词既能指提名某人，也能指提出动议。

intro.en: Propose comes from Latin pro- forward and ponere to place, through the French verb proposer; the same stem with the noun ending -al gives proposal.
intro.cn: propose 来自拉丁语 pro-（向前）加 ponere（放置），经法语动词 proposer 进入英语；同一个词干加上名词后缀 -al，就成了 proposal。

items.en: Ponere meant to place, set down, or fix in position, and it is the source of a large family of English words.
items.cn: ponere 意为「放置、放下、固定在某处」，是英语中一大族词的来源。

items.en: With pro- meaning forward, proponere meant to put forward or set before someone, often as an offer.
items.cn: 加上表示「向前」的 pro-，proponere 意为「向前摆出、呈现给某人」，常带「献上」的意味。

items.en: Old French proposer carried the sense of suggesting or setting out, and English took the verb in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 古法语 proposer 带有「建议、陈述」的意思，英语在十四世纪借入这个动词。

items.en: Modern English propose covers plans, intentions, marriage and nominations, while proposal names the thing offered.
items.cn: 现代英语的 propose 覆盖计划、意图、求婚与提名，而 proposal 指被献出的那个东西。

items.en: Propose ends in a silent e, which drops before the noun ending -al, so propos- plus -al becomes proposal, never proposeal.
items.cn: propose 以不发音的 e 结尾，遇到名词后缀 -al 时这个 e 脱落，于是 propos- 加 -al 写作 proposal，而不会写成 proposeal。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the noun and the Latin relatives of the verb; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of putting an idea or a name forward.
note.cn: 形近组收这个动词的名词形式与拉丁同族词；近义组收「提出想法或名字」的动词。

entries.definition: A statement or idea offered for discussion or proof.

entries.definition: To put forward an idea or theory for serious consideration.

entries.definition: The aim of an action; only the spelling looks alike, and the origin is different.

entries.definitionCN: 提出一个想法供人考虑。

entries.definition: To advise that something is a good choice.
entries.definitionCN: 建议某事物是好选择。

entries.definition: To formally name someone for a position.
entries.definitionCN: 正式提名某人担任某职。

entries.definition: To have something in mind as a plan.
entries.definitionCN: 心里打算做某事。

normalIntro.en: The verb is built from pro- forward and ponere to place, and its noun keeps the same stem with -al instead of a final e.
normalIntro.cn: 这个动词由 pro-（向前）与 ponere（放置）构成，它的名词用同一词干加 -al，而不用末尾的 e。

normal.en: Propose is pro- forward plus ponere to place: to place an idea before people.
normal.cn: propose 是 pro-（向前）加 ponere（放置）：把想法摆到众人面前。

normal.en: Proposal is the same stem with -al, and the e of propose drops, so the noun is spelled propos-al.
normal.cn: proposal 是同一词干加 -al，propose 的 e 脱落，所以名词拼作 propos-al。

normal.en: Propose a toast and propose a plan use the same gesture of holding something out to others.
normal.cn: propose a toast 与 propose a plan 用的是同一个「把东西端给别人」的动作。

normal.en: Propose to someone keeps the offer image, with a shared life as the thing offered.
normal.cn: propose to someone 保留了「献上」的意象，只是献出的东西变成共同的生活。

normal.en: Propose a motion and propose a candidate both put a wording or a name in front of a group for a vote.
normal.cn: propose a motion 与 propose a candidate 都是把一段文字或一个名字摆到一群人面前等待表决。

abstract.en: The verb is an open hand: whatever it offers must be visible to the people who will decide.
abstract.cn: 这个动词就是一只摊开的手：它献出的东西必须让将要决定的人看得见。

abstract.en: A plan, a marriage and a name all travel the same path, from a private thought to a public table.
abstract.cn: 计划、婚姻与名字走的是同一条路：从私下的念头，到公开的桌面上。

abstract.en: The missing e in proposal is the trace of the verb handing its meaning over to the noun.
abstract.cn: proposal 里少掉的那个 e，正是动词把意义交给名词时留下的痕迹。

examples.en: The city proposed a new bike lane along the river.
examples.cn: 市里提议沿河修一条新的自行车道。

examples.en: He proposed to her after dinner.
examples.cn: 晚饭后，他向她求婚。

examples.en: They propose to move the office closer to the station.
examples.cn: 他们打算把办公室搬到离车站更近的地方。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「普若剖子」——把想法剖开摆到桌上，就是 propose，提议。

root: 拉丁语 pro-（向前）+ ponere（放置）→ proponere（摆到前面）→ 古法语 proposer → 英语 propose；去 e 加 -al 即得 proposal，两者同源，词义都围绕「把东西摆到人前」。

sensesIntro.en: The core is setting something before people; the senses divide into a plan, an offer of marriage, a stated intention, and a formal nomination.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是「把东西摆到人前」；义项由此分为计划、婚姻的献出、已说明的意图，以及正式提名。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pushing a sheet of notes to the middle of the table and looking up at the others.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把一张写满要点的纸推到桌子中央，抬头看向众人。

branches.en: a rough timetable pushed across a round table
branches.cn: 一张粗糙的时间表被推过圆桌

branches.en: a ring held out by the river at dusk
branches.cn: 黄昏时在河边递出的戒指

branches.en: a council paper stating what it means to do
branches.cn: 市政文件写明它打算做什么

branches.en: a name read aloud and seconded in a hall
branches.cn: 礼堂里念出一个名字并有人附议

branches.en: one verb for offering a plan and offering a life
branches.cn: 同一个动词，既献出方案，也献出一生

intro.en: The word is held together by the Latin verb ponere, the prefix pro-, the French verb proposer, and the English nouns proposal and proposition.
intro.cn: 这个词由拉丁动词 ponere、前缀 pro-、法语动词 proposer，以及英语名词 proposal 与 proposition 共同支撑。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有可靠的拉丁同族词记录。

items.meaning: to put forward, to ask in marriage
a plan or offer put forward

definition_en: to include someone or something as a necessary part, or to draw a person into an activity or problem
core_image: 一张卷起的纸，把旁边的东西一层层包进去
scene: 事故现场拉着警戒线，几个路过的人也被记录成了证人。 The delay involved three separate repairs and two inspections.
sceneCN: 这里 involve 是「涉及」（第 1 个义项：把某事作为组成部分包含在内），句意为这次延误涉及三轮维修和两次检查。画面里的物件：警戒线、记录本、铁皮。

pos.zh: 动词：涉及；包含；使卷入；需要

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ment 构成，义为「参与；牵连」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「复杂的；有关的」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「引人入胜的」
同带 volv- 词根的形近词，义为「进化；演变」

senses.title: Having something as a part
senses.definition: to include something as a necessary part of a process or situation
senses.definitionCN: 把某物作为过程或情形中必要的一部分包含进来
senses.example: The job involves long hours in cold rooms.
senses.exampleCN: 这份工作需要长时间待在冷库里。
senses.why: involvere rolled things inside; a job that includes a task has rolled the task in.
senses.whyCN: involvere 是把东西卷在里面；一份工作含有某项任务，就是把它卷了进来。

senses.title: Drawing people in
senses.definition: to make someone take part in or be affected by something
senses.definitionCN: 使人参与某事或受到某事影响
senses.example: The decision involved every member of the village.
senses.exampleCN: 这个决定牵涉到村里的每一个人。
senses.why: People wrapped into a matter are involved parties, whether they wished it or not.
senses.whyCN: 被卷进一件事的人就是当事方，愿不愿意都一样。

senses.title: Being complicated
senses.definition: to become difficult because many parts are tangled together
senses.definitionCN: 因为许多部分缠在一起而变得难以处理
senses.example: The case grew more involved with each new witness.
senses.exampleCN: 随着新证人出现，这个案子变得越来越复杂。
senses.why: Many threads rolled tight make a knot: that is the complicated sense.
senses.whyCN: 许多线被紧紧卷在一起就成了结，这就是「复杂」那一层。

intro.en: Involve comes from Latin involvere, "to roll up, to wrap", which is literally a paper rolled around something.
intro.cn: involve 来自拉丁语 involvere「卷起、包裹」，字面就是纸把东西卷进去。

items.en: The verb volvere meant "to roll".
items.cn: 动词 volvere 意为「滚、卷」。

items.en: in- added the idea of inward motion, giving involvere, "to roll in".
items.cn: in- 加上向内，构成 involvere「卷进去」。

items.en: The verb was used of wrapping things in cloth or mist.
items.cn: 这个词被用来指用布或雾把东西包起来。

items.en: French took it in as involver, "to wrap up".
items.cn: 法语以 involver「包裹」吸收它。

items.en: The wrapped sense turned into the social sense of being entangled in a matter.
items.cn: 「包住」义转成在社会事务中被缠住的含义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -volve stem; the near-meaning group holds words for including or entangling.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -volve 词干；近义组收表示包含或牵连的词。

entries.definition: To develop gradually over time.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「演变」，同一词干换前缀。

entries.definition: To turn around a centre.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「旋转」，同词干。

entries.definition: Complicated, or taking part in something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「复杂的；有关的」，同族词。

entries.definition: To have something as part of a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「包括」，最中性。

entries.definition: To make something necessary as a result.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「必然涉及」，偏后果。

entries.definition: To twist into a complicated situation.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「缠住」，偏麻烦。

normalIntro.en: These hooks all start with a sheet of paper being rolled up.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子都从一张被卷起的纸开始。

normal.en: in- means in, and volv- means roll.
normal.cn: in- 是「向内」，volv- 是「卷」。

normal.en: Involve is to roll something into the middle.
normal.cn: involve 就是把东西卷到里面去。

normal.en: What gets rolled in is involved in the affair.
normal.cn: 被卷进去的，就是牵扯其中的。

normal.en: Revolve rolls around an axis; evolve rolls out.
normal.cn: revolve 绕轴卷，evolve 向外卷开。

normal.en: Adding -ment gives the state of involvement.
normal.cn: 加 -ment 就是 involvement 这个状态。

abstract.en: To involve is to fold someone into the story.
abstract.cn: involve 就是把某人褶进这个故事里。

abstract.en: Every wrapped thing has edges you did not plan.
abstract.cn: 每一个被包住的东西都有你没算到的折角。

abstract.en: Complication is many threads rolled tight.
abstract.cn: 复杂就是许多线被紧紧卷在一起。

examples.en: The repair involves replacing the whole pump.
examples.cn: 这次维修要更换整个水泵。

examples.en: Parents were involved in planning the new playground.
examples.cn: 家长参与了新游乐场的筹划。

examples.en: Keep the story simple; the readers do not want an involved plot.
examples.cn: 故事写简单些，读者不想要错综复杂的情节。

dict_mnemonic.text: in（进去）+ volve（卷）——被卷进来

root: 拉丁语 in「进入」+ volvere「卷」→ involvere「卷进去、包裹」→ 古法语 involver → 英语 involve。同族有 involvement、involved；形近 revolve、evolve。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: including a part, drawing people in, and becoming tangled and complex.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：包含组成部分、把人牵进来，以及变得盘根错节。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sheet rolled inward until other things are inside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张纸向内卷起，把别的东西也裹了进去。

branches.en: THE STEPS: what a job or plan must contain.
branches.cn: 步骤这条线：一份工作或计划必须含有的环节。

branches.en: THE PEOPLE: everyone rolled into the matter.
branches.cn: 人物这条线：被卷进这件事的所有人。

branches.en: THE KNOT: a case too tangled to explain quickly.
branches.cn: 绳结这条线：复杂到一时说不清的案子。

branches.en: THE WEB: parts and people are bound by the same thread.
branches.cn: 网这条线：组成部分与人被同一根线连着。

branches.en: THE COST: drawing people in is what makes things complicated.
branches.cn: 代价这条线：把人牵进来，事情才变复杂。

intro.en: Involve is in- "into" plus volv- "roll".
intro.cn: involve 是 in-「进入」加 volv-「卷」。

latinIntro.en: Latin volvere and involvere are both recorded roll-words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 volvere 与 involvere 都是有记载的「卷」类词。

items.example: The root also drives revolve and evolve.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也带动 revolve 与 evolve。

items.example: It forms involved, tangled or related.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 involved，纠结或有关的。
它构成 involving，引人入胜的。

items.example: The verb is the family base.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是这一族的基座。

items.example: The re- prefix sends it around.
The e- prefix rolls it outward.
items.exampleCN: e- 前缀把它向外卷开。

definition_en: in a similar way
core_image: 两条平行的路并肩伸向远方
scene: 同样地，第二组也失败了。 Similarly, the second group failed.
sceneCN: 这里 similarly 是「同样地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：同样地，第二组也失败了。

senses.title: In the same way
senses.definition: in the same or a very close way
senses.definitionCN: 以相同或非常接近的方式
senses.example: Similarly, the second group failed.
senses.exampleCN: 同样地，第二组也失败了。
senses.why: This is the basic likeness adverb.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的相似副词义项。

senses.title: Also, by comparison
senses.definition: used to add a second case that resembles the first
senses.definitionCN: 用来补充与第一种情况相似的另一例
senses.example: Similarly, prices rose in other cities.
senses.exampleCN: 类似地，其他城市的价格也上涨了。
senses.why: The adverb links two parallel cases.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词连接两个平行的例子。

intro.en: Similarly is similar plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: similarly 是 similar 加上副词后缀 -ly。

items.en: Similis meant like.
items.cn: similis 意为相像的。

items.en: The word entered French as similaire.
items.cn: 这个词以 similaire 进入法语。

items.en: English borrowed similar.
items.cn: 英语借入 similar。

items.en: The adverb similarly joined clauses.
items.cn: 副词 similarly 用来连接从句。

items.en: It marked parallel facts in writing.
items.cn: 它在写作中标出平行的事实。

note.en: Similarly is compared with similar-looking words and with linking words.
note.cn: 把 similarly 与形近词以及连接词作比较。

entries.definition: almost the same
entries.definitionCN: 相似的

entries.definition: the state of being alike
entries.definitionCN: 相似性

entries.definition: easy to understand
entries.definitionCN: 简单的

entries.definition: in the same way
entries.definitionCN: 同样地

entries.definition: to the same degree
entries.definitionCN: 同样地

entries.definition: in a matching way
entries.definitionCN: 相应地

normalIntro.en: Similarly puts a second case beside the first.
normalIntro.cn: similarly 把第二种情况放在第一种旁边。

normal.en: Similarly, the second group failed.
normal.cn: 同样地，第二组也失败了。

normal.en: Similarly, prices rose in other cities.
normal.cn: 类似地，其他城市的价格也上涨了。

normal.en: Both teams were similarly affected.
normal.cn: 两队受到的影响相似。

normal.en: The two houses are similarly priced.
normal.cn: 两栋房子价格相近。

normal.en: They think similarly about the plan.
normal.cn: 他们对这个计划的想法类似。

abstract.en: Similarly is a bridge between two facts.
abstract.cn: similarly 是两件事实之间的桥。

abstract.en: Parallel lines never meet but always agree.
abstract.cn: 平行线永不相交，却始终一致。

abstract.en: One example can quietly explain another.
abstract.cn: 一个例子能悄悄解释另一个。

examples.en: Similarly, the second group failed.
examples.cn: 同样地，第二组也失败了。

examples.en: Similarly, prices rose in other cities.
examples.cn: 类似地，其他城市的价格也上涨了。

examples.en: Both teams were similarly affected.
examples.cn: 两队受到的影响相似。

dict_mnemonic.text: similar（相似的）加 -ly 变副词：用相似的方式做、说或发生，就是 similarly（同样地）。

root: 由 similar（相似的）加副词后缀 -ly 构成，核心义「以相似的方式」。

sensesIntro.en: Similarly means in the same or a closely related way.
sensesIntro.cn: similarly 意为以相同或相近的方式。

core.en: A second fact walking in the same step.
core.cn: 第二件事实迈着同样的步子。

branches.en: The second group fails the same way.
branches.cn: 第二组以同样方式失败。

branches.en: Other cities repeat the pattern.
branches.cn: 其他城市重复这一模式。

branches.en: Two houses share a price.
branches.cn: 两栋房子价格相同。

branches.en: The adverb links parallel cases.
branches.cn: 这个副词连接平行的情况。

branches.en: Comparison turns facts into a pattern.
branches.cn: 比较把事实变成模式。

intro.en: Similarly belongs to the similar family of likeness words.
intro.cn: similarly 属于 similar 这一相似词族。

latinIntro.en: Similarly comes from Latin similis, like.
latinIntro.cn: similarly 来自拉丁语 similis（相像的）。
